name: Ryderwear
known_for: Gym Wear Cut for Muscular Builds

prices.note: Men's T-Shirts collection (116 products, US store): 59 regular-price short-sleeve tees $50 (Energy Mesh T-Shirt) to $65 (Pursuit Oversized T-shirt, Throwback Oversized Fleece T-Shirt); Element and Aero Core Seamless T-Shirts $52, Ryderwear/Force/Lifting Oversized Tshirts $59. 49 items with compare-at prices excluded. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price and no markdown tag (markdown, clearance, outlet, final, DiscountApplied, sale-NN, NN%, on-sale, sale, flash-sale, further reductions); campaign-eligibility tags with no compare-at price (e.g. '10th-anniversary-sale', 'cp:SeptEOSSale', 'DISCOUNT') are not treated as markdowns. Short-sleeve tees only: long-sleeve, tanks, stringers, polos, button-ups, jerseys, sweaters, packs and box sets excluded.

notes: About: 'Created in Australia 2009, the Ryderwear brand is the ultimate definition of fitness plus fashion'; 'Every item ... is specifically designed to mould to the muscular physique of athletes and bodybuilders of any size.' meta.json store address Beverley, South Australia.

US shipping: free standard on orders of $120 USD and over; 'All US orders are sold inclusive of customs and duties'; ships from its distribution center to customers across the United States. meta.json (US store) ships_to includes US and CA.
Returns: eligible items within 30 days of delivery for store credit; exchanges with an extra shipping fee; outlet items not returnable unless faulty.
size_range detail: XS–XXL on most; 3XL on 55 of 59.
